ngen: pilot-manifest-format (fill per run, commit alongside code)
pilot: Gangtok cluster, Sikkim + Darjeeling corridor, W Bengal (D1-D4 rows 5-8, same 22-col schema)

imd_gridded.grid_method: nearest to S1 27.3450N 88.6000E (~13 km; 0.25 deg representativeness limit applies)
imd_gridded.window_rule: wettest trailing-7d spell of 2024 at pilot cell

cci_soil.version: ESA CCI SM COMBINED TCDR v202505 (DOI 10.24381/cds.d7782f18)
cci_soil.source: CDS user download 2026-09-04 (user-selected: volumetric, combined, daily, June 10-16 2024)
cci_soil.method: nearest 0.25-degree cell (27.375,88.625) per slope per day; reliability-killer flag bits 4|8|16|32 masked (none hit: 7/7 valid, flags=[0]); window-mean per slope = 0.271 all slopes (same-cell consequence, stated)
cci_soil.note: satellite-observed (stronger than ERA5 reanalysis); CDS-request path for ERA5 proper was never needed

srtm_dem.version: USGS SRTM 1 Arc-Second Global v3 (SRTMGL1.003) — REAL, mirror superseded 2026-09-04
tiles: n27_e088_1arc_v3.tif (3601x3601 int16, EPSG:4326, bounds 88-89E/27-28N, LOCAL ONLY per .gitignore)
srtm_dem.method: bilinear elev; Horn-1981 anisotropic; Laplacian curv; D8 priority-flood TWI=ln(a/tanB) SPI=a*tanB on 7.7x5.9km crop; 90 voids (0.17%) neighbour-mean filled, slope neighbourhoods void-free
srtm_dem.usgs_vs_mirror: elev within 7m all slopes (mirror grid validated); slope/aspect/curv/TWI/SPI differ by resolution (30m native vs smoothed 4-8m) — documented per-slope deltas in usgs_s234.json; curvature sign flips are scale effects, stated
srtm_dem.previous_mirror: Terrarium z15/z14 extracts retained under data/processed/terrain/ as method audit trail

sentinel2.method: ndvi=(NIR-R)/(NIR+R) at exact S1; DN red=390 nir=2380 scl=4 (vegetation); lulc from OSM landuse PROXY (none in 300m, stays STUB)
sentinel2.ndvi_date_note: scene 2024-11-29 post-monsoon vs row time_window 2024-06-16; NDVI treated as quasi-static state
sentinel2.s234_script: scripts/extract_s234_ndvi.py (same pinned scene: S2 ndvi 0.139 scl=bare, S3 0.817 veg, S4 0.468 veg)
sentinel2.lulc_attempt: SUPERSEDED 2026-09-04 by WorldCover (below): OSM landuse round found nothing mappable ≤300 m; WC 10m map gives direct reads.

worldcover.tile: N27E087 (27-30N/87-90E, EPSG:4326, 36000x36000; bounds verified in-repo, all 4 slopes inside)
worldcover.access: AWS Open Data, no sign-in (Terrascope login NOT needed)
worldcover.extract_script: scripts/extract_s234_lulc.py (rasterio /vsicurl/ range reads, 3x3-window mode per slope, system py311)
worldcover.method: 3x3 mode class + centre agreement (9/9 all slopes); mapping 10->FOREST, 50->BUILT (full table in extract JSON)
worldcover.crosscheck: consistent with NDVI (S1 0.718/S3 0.817 veg vs S2 0.139 bare road-cut); S4 BUILT matches Ranipool settlement

bhusanket.source: user-supplied GSI_Landslide_Inventory.shp.zip (30,842 point slides, all-India, LOCAL ONLY per .gitignore)
bhusanket.join: data/sih26001/evidence/sikkim_join.json (per-slope haversine join over all 693 Sikkim points)
bhusanket.method: previous_landslide=1 iff slide within 300m (ID cited); event=1 only if dated in-window (INITIATION is year-or-0, so 0 with reason); S2 hit SK/ESK/78A11/2019/02 at 286.7m

gsi_report.version: landslide_report.pdf Sikkim block p659-676 (904 pp, producer pypdf, no TOC)
gsi_report.join_note: corroboration only in sikkim_join.json report_pdf block; shapefile join outcomes unchanged (S2 prev=1 now with second ID SI/GTK/78A11/2025/03 Upper Sichey @259 m; S1/S3/S4 stay 0; all events 0, histories Mar 2023..Jul 2025 outside 2024-06-10/16 window)
gsi_report.method: DISTRICT == Gangtok District filter over pp. 659-676 (first SK Sl.26052 p659 foot; p677 Tripura); haversine corroboration join, same 300 m rule

bhukosh.source: data/raw/docs/Gangtok_Disaster_Resilience_Action_Plan.pdf (230 pp, Figure 25/48 Lithology Map Gangtok, Source: NESAC; SSDMA+GSI) + CGWB Gangtok 2025 corroboration — LOCAL ONLY per .gitignore
bhukosh.method: digitized published NESAC map: all 4 central-Gangtok pilot points (27.315-27.345N/88.595-88.612E, Fig 9-25 town extent) lie on 'lingtse_granite_gneiss' (intrusive, highly weathered, soil <1-10m); Chungthang/Darjeeling/Phyllite noted as nearby units not at pilot points
bhukosh.limit: 50K figure resolution; Chungthang subgroup (biotite gneiss etc.) is immediate country rock per CGWB; replace with Bhukosh vector clip when reachable

lineament.version: Bhuvan Lineament 50K 2005-06 Sikkim, layer lineament:SK_LN50K_0506 (NRSC, in association with GSI) + NMHS Figure 24/47 context — VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-04
lineament.source: ISRO/NRSC Bhuvan WMS GetCapabilities https://bhuvan-vec2.nrsc.gov.in/bhuvan/wms?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities&VERSION=1.1.1 (5.2 MB, bbox 88.035/27.073-88.892/28.061) lists lineament:SK_LN50K_0506 queryable=1 + Thematic portal bhuvan-app1.nrsc.gov.in/mines/mines.php Sikkim listed + nwdp.nwic.in/dataset/lineament ('in association with GSI') + data/raw/docs/Gangtok_Disaster_Resilience_Action_Plan.pdf Figures 24/47
lineament.extract_script: scripts/extract_lineament.py (pymupdf figure-index check + literature value; WMS probe logged in JSON)
lineament.method: Bhuvan WMS GetCapabilities verified layer exists and covers Gangtok; WFS disabled (ServiceUnavailable), GetMap KML forbidden (ForbiddenFormat), GetFeatureInfo at Gangtok AOI + state centre returned 0 features — WMS renders but vector not exposed via GetFeatureInfo from this client, so literature proxy 0.8 km/km2 for all 4 points (conservative <1.5 on density map, literature 0.3-1.4, uniform because 50K figure not per-slope digitized; stronger than DEM-edge fabrication)
lineament.tag: PROXY-published-map + Bhuvan-availability (verified layer SK_LN50K_0506, not a vector clip)
lineament.limit: 50K scale; vector not exposed via GetFeatureInfo; replace via Bhuvan Thematic portal → Sikkim Lineament 50K → clip Gangtok AOI (88.58-88.63E/27.30-27.36N) → export KML/Shapefile (GWC demo lists KML) → QGIS length/area → km/km2 in projected CRS per published Sikkim method

darjeeling_ngen.sentinel2: Element84 STAC least-cloudy 2024 scene covering all D: S2B_45RXK_20241129_0_L2A (sibling granule of Gangtok scene, same date, cloud 0.02%), NDVI D1 0.688/D2 0.848/D3 0.880/D4 0.821 scl=4 REAL post-monsoon quasi-static
